annotations.title: Fact check, verify a claim: against live web sources

description: Check a claim against the live web in one call: a Brave search, the top pages read, and a verdict from Llama 4 Scout using those sources only (supported, contradicted, mixed or unverified) with a short explanation, [n] citations and the sources. A model's reading of a few search results, not an editorial fact-check. Results are for immediate use only (Brave API terms). Use to screen a statement before an agent repeats or acts on it. Example: claim=The x402 protocol uses the HTTP 402 Payment Required status code.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

claim.description: The claim to check, at most 400 characters
